consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.description: HSEQ consulting for Australian construction: IMS design and implementation, gap analysis, internal audit support, workplace inspections, custom SWMS, incident investigation and advisory retainers.

consulting-ims-design-implementation.title: IMS design and implementation
consulting-ims-design-implementation.description: We design your management system and help you put it in place: aligned to ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment) and ISO 45001 (health and safety), on its own or as one integrated management system (IMS) that fits how your business works.

consulting-gap-analysis.title: Gap analysis
consulting-gap-analysis.description: A structured review of your current system against ISO 9001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001, or against what a principal contractor or prequalification scheme asks for, with a prioritised list of what to fix.

consulting-internal-audit-support.title: Internal audit support
consulting-internal-audit-support.description: Independent internal audits of your management system: before a certification or surveillance audit, before a client audit, or as part of your own audit programme, reported with clear findings and corrective actions.

consulting-workplace-inspections.title: Workplace inspections
consulting-workplace-inspections.description: Workplace and site inspections, one-off or as a programme (monthly, or at an interval agreed with you), with photos, findings and corrective action requests your team can close out.

consulting-custom-swms.title: Custom SWMS development
consulting-custom-swms.description: Safe work method statements written for your actual task, site and crew, including high risk construction work, rather than a stock template with your logo on it.

consulting-incident-investigation.title: Incident investigation
consulting-incident-investigation.description: A structured investigation after an incident or near miss: what happened, why it happened and what will stop it happening again, written up so your team and your client can follow it.

consulting-advisory-retainers.title: Advisory retainers
consulting-advisory-retainers.description: Ongoing HSEQ support from a senior practitioner: an agreed amount of help every month, without scoping and quoting each job.

consulting-custom-content.title: Custom content, on request
consulting-custom-content.description: Video content made for your business, on request: a full site-specific induction video, custom toolbox talks or a company induction video, kept private to you.

library.title: Document library
library.description: 780+ controlled HSEQ documents: 215 SWMS across 28 trade series, ITPs, plans, policies, forms and registers, reviewed every 6 months.
